title: The Accuracy of Rotary Encoders — Installation-Induced Error Sources
locator: Rotary encoder ring eccentricity, swash, geometric distortion, harmonic error, installed accuracy and multiple-readhead compensation discussion
notes: Renishaw technical explanation of installation-induced rotary scale errors. The article's test examples and multiple-readhead compensation discussion are specific to the described ring systems and geometries; do not assume two readheads cancel all errors or apply its numerical examples to other designs.
